summary: Core production types (CandidateRefreshSummary, ReconcileAndRefreshResult, GitCheckoutTargetBranchStateProvider) and the reconcile_and_refresh_stale_candidates() function are implemented with full test coverage. However, the worker.py wiring is incomplete: the _post_merge_reconciler closure exists (lines 84-108) but the PR monitor kwargs on line 152 still point to target_branch_reconciler.reconcile instead of the new wrapper, so the staleness refresh will never run in production.
gaps: worker.py line 152 assigns post_merge_target_reconciler=target_branch_reconciler.reconcile instead of _post_merge_reconciler. The closure that wraps reconcile_and_refresh_stale_candidates is defined but unused, so post-merge staleness refresh is dead code in production wiring.

test_worker.py does not verify that post_merge_target_reconciler is the _post_merge_reconciler closure (it only checks callable and key presence); add an assertion that calling the reconciler triggers the staleness refresh path (e.g. by checking it is not the bare monitor.reconcile method).
